title: Shape-aware W8A16 decode GEMV and tensor-core prefill GEMM
clocks: GPU locked at 1020 MHz via scripts/lock_clocks.sh

precision.storage: int8 weights + bf16 group-64 scales + bf16 activations

implementation.decode_gemv_k_le_1024: gemv_w8a16_fast_kernel<8,1>: one warp per output row, 8 rows per block; int4 (16 int8) weight loads, one group-64 scale per 16-element chunk; shared input staging; FP32 FMA; warp shuffle reduction; fused bias
implementation.decode_gemv_tail: linear_w8a16_kernel fallback for K%16!=0, K%64!=0 (partial groups), misaligned pointers
implementation.prefill_gemm_small: gemm_w8a16_wmma_async_kernel (BlockM=32, BlockN=64, BlockK=64, 256 threads) for tokens%32==0
implementation.prefill_gemm_large: gemm_w8a16_wmma_async_m128n128_kernel (BlockM=128, BlockN=128, BlockK=32, 512 threads, 4 accumulators) for tokens%128==0 && out%128==0
implementation.prefill_gemm_dequant: cp.async raw int8 tile + bf16 input tile into double-buffered shared; shared-memory dequant pass (int8 x bf16 scale -> bf16, packed __floats2bfloat162_rn with 32-bit stores); then bf16 WMMA mma_sync. The dequant result is necessarily rounded to bf16, introducing ~1 ULP/element noise vs the exact fp32-FMA path
implementation.prefill_gemm_tail: linear_w8a16_kernel fallback for non-64-multiple K or non-divisible tokens
implementation.lm_head: unchanged from CP19: fused BF16 tied LM head + argmax (tie->min index) shared with W16
implementation.tool_fix: linear_benchmark now dequantizes W8 weights host-side to BF16 for the cuBLAS comparison; previously the raw INT8 buffer was reinterpreted as BF16 (2x OOB reads, illegal memory access at 4864-row layers)

correctness.canonical_greedy_16_tokens: 14/16 identical to W16; token 7 (Language->Model) and token 16 (It->that) flipped
correctness.greedy_divergence_cause: bf16 rounding of the dequantized weight in the tensor-core GEMM (2^-9 per element) propagates through 24 layers to ~1e-3 logit noise, flipping borderline greedy tokens. Old fp32-FMA GEMM was exact and matched W16 16/16
correctness.greedy_divergence_decision: accepted and documented (option a): W8A16 top-1 parity holds; the W8 quantization itself is a larger perturbation than this; restoring exact greedy via hi/lo split or fp32-FMA would cost 1.6x-20x prefill speed

canonical_greedy_16_of_16.note: accepted: borderline flips from bf16 dequant rounding in tensor-core GEMM; documented in report
